lead.claim: Combine CBT and Pilates for better balance and gait in MS patients.
lead.context: Adding fatigue-focused CBT to Pilates-based core stability training improved balance and gait in multiple sclerosis patients, outperforming Pilates alone.

supporting.claim: Is home-based stroke rehab as good as in-person for upper limb recovery?
supporting.context: Why this matters: *This systematic review and meta-analysis investigated whether self-guided home-based rehabilitation for upper limb recovery in stroke patients was comparable to other interventions.

supporting.claim: Start rehab on day one for acute stroke patients with heart failure.
supporting.context: Why this matters: *This retrospective cohort study examined the impact of very early rehabilitation on safety and efficacy in acute stroke patients who also had heart failure.

supporting.claim: Assess community participation in children with probable DCD.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This cross-sectional study examined motor skills and community participation in children with suspected developmental coordination difficulties, using the ICF framework.

supporting.claim: Manual technique choice for headache depends on provider, not just headache type.
supporting.context: Why this matters: *This systematic review of randomized controlled trials analyzed how manual techniques are delivered for headache, focusing on factors influencing technique selection.
